technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Add batching options (batchingEnabled, batchingSize, bufferLimit, timeout) to the Rabbit sink module using Spring AMQP BatchingRabbitTemplate.

U2: Develop Gradle plugin extension/convention to automatically set provided dependencies, apply Spring Boot plugin configuration with 'MODULE' layout, and reduce build boilerplate for XD module projects.
U3: Add acceptance tests for the hdfs-dataset module using an embedded/local HDFS cluster instance and integrate tests into the CI pipeline.
U4: Refactor compression support to introduce an extensible CompressionCodec SPI allowing custom implementations and user-defined default overrides.

U5 & U6: Utilize standard Spring XD performance benchmarking harnesses to benchmark Rabbit sink under batching (default size 100, varied sizes) and compression enabled; compare results against baseline performance snapshots.
U7: Refactor DIRT runtime auto-configuration to make Relational Database (RDBMS/DataSource) dependencies optional, allowing pure stream processing workloads to execute without a database setup.
U8: Design and implement a reactive processor module interface bridging Spring Integration MessageHandler contracts with RxJava Observable pipeline APIs.
assumptions: All work will be performed by a single developer familiar with Java 17+, Spring Framework, Spring XD, Spring Integration, and Gradle.
Local testing infrastructure (RabbitMQ broker, mock HDFS environment, CI server) is available and functional.
Performance benchmarking hardware/testbed remains consistent with previous baseline runs.
Unit, integration, and regression testing activities are included within the estimated effort for each task.

activities.activity_name: Implement Batching Support for Rabbit Sink (U1)
activities.activity_description: Expose batching configuration options in Rabbit sink module parameters, integrate with BatchingRabbitTemplate, and add unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement Gradle Build Option for XD Modules (U2)
activities.activity_description: Configure Gradle build options and conventions for XD module projects to set provided scope and configure Spring Boot 'MODULE' layout.

activities.activity_name: Add Acceptance Tests for HDFS-Dataset Module in CI (U3)
activities.activity_description: Write automated acceptance test suite covering dataset source/sink functionality and integrate execution into CI build pipelines.
Refactor compression strategy to allow overriding defaults and registering custom codecs/strategies; add unit tests.
Run baseline benchmarks with Rabbit batching enabled across varied batch sizes (e.g., 50, 100, 500), collect metrics, and generate comparison reports.
Re-run benchmark suites with payload/transport compression enabled on Rabbit, analyze throughput/latency impact, and compare against baseline snapshots.

activities.activity_name: Disable DB Requirement for DIRT Stream Processing (U7)
activities.activity_description: Make DataSource configuration optional in DIRT container for pure stream processing setups, update runtime initialization, and verify DB-less startup.
Implement core interface contract and adapter infrastructure allowing developers to construct processor modules using RxJava APIs.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across all modified modules, resolve regressions, and verify build pipeline stability.
